# Claude Code Subagents: Frontmatter and `--agents` JSON

An agent file is a Markdown file that defines a subagent.
The keys at the top of the file (the frontmatter) set its name, tools, model, and limits, and the body is its prompt.
For example, a file with `name: reviewer` and `tools: Read, Grep` makes a read-only review agent.
Claude Code `2.1.303` reads the keys below.

## Legend

- ✅ documented in the saved docs.
- 🔍 undocumented, found in the bundle.
- ⚠️ the docs differ from the bundle.
- 🧪 behind a flag or a gate.
  The gate is in the cell.
- ❌ removed or inert in `2.1.303`.

## Keys

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `name` | Unique identifier of the agent. | At most 256 characters. Must not start with `-` or contain `:`. Hooks receive it as `agent_type`. A file with no `name` is treated as documentation. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `description` | When Claude should delegate to the agent. | Required. A file with `name` but no `description` is skipped. Literal `\n` becomes a newline. Not allowed to be empty in `--agents` JSON. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `tools` | Allowlist of tools. | Comma-separated string or YAML list. Omitted: inherit all tools available to subagents. `Agent(a, b)` limits spawnable types for a `--agent` main thread. `mcp__server__*` selects a whole server. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ⚠️ | `disallowedTools` | Denylist of tools. | Docs: applied first, then `tools` resolves against the rest. An entry such as `Bash(git push *)` removes the whole tool, and `mcp__github__*` withholds MCP tools. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `model` | Model of the agent. | `sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, `fable`, a full model ID, or `inherit`. Order: per-call `model`, this field, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`, main model. `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1` forces one model. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `permissionMode` | Permission mode of the agent. | `default`, `acceptEdits`, `auto`, `dontAsk`, `bypassPermissions`, `plan`, or `manual` (same as `default`). `bypassPermissions` applies only when the main session has it. Ignored for plugin agents. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. Not in plugin agents. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `maxTurns` | Most agentic turns before the agent stops. | Positive integer. At the limit the output returns marked partial and the agent can be resumed. The bundle accepts a number or a string. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `autoCompactWindow` | Lowers the auto-compact window of this agent. | Integer from `100000` to `1000000`. Needs `2.1.296`. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `skills` | Skills preloaded into the agent context. | The full skill text is injected, for at most 32 names. A skill with `disable-model-invocation: true` cannot be preloaded, and a missing skill is skipped and logged. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `mcpServers` | MCP servers for this agent. | List of server names (reference) or inline `{name: config}` objects. Inline servers connect at start and disconnect at end, under the trust rule for the agent file folder. Ignored for plugin agents. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. Not in plugin agents. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `hooks` | Lifecycle hooks scoped to this agent. | Events `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop` (becomes `SubagentStop`). Ignored for plugin agents. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. Not in plugin agents. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `memory` | Persistent memory scope. | `user` is `~/.claude/agent-memory/<name>/`, `project` is `.claude/agent-memory/<name>/`, `local` is `.claude/agent-memory-local/<name>/`. An invalid value is logged and dropped. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `background` | Keeps the agent in the background. | `true` or `false` (string or boolean). Any other value logs an error. A teammate may not spawn such an agent. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `omitClaudeMd` | Starts without user, project, and local `CLAUDE.md`. | `true` only. Managed policy files still load. Explore, Plan, and the web-reading agent set it. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `effort` | Effort level while the agent is active. | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. The bundle text also lists an integer. `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` wins. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `isolation` | Runs the agent in a temporary git worktree. | `worktree` in the docs. The bundle schema also accepts `remote`. Branched from the default branch. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `color` | Display color. | `red`, `blue`, `green`, `yellow`, `purple`, `orange`, `pink`, `cyan`. The bundle calls it an internal display color. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `initialPrompt` | First user turn when the agent is the main session. | Used with `--agent` or the `agent` setting. Commands and skills are processed. Not read when spawned as a subagent. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. Main session only. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| ✅ | `experimental` | Map of experimental options. | `cacheTtl`: `5m` or `1h` sets the prompt cache TTL when no `subagentPromptCacheTtl` setting or env var is set. `1h` is ignored in subscription overage. Unknown keys are ignored. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |
| 🔍 🧪 | `observer` | Agent type auto-spawned as a background observer whenever this agent runs. | String, trimmed. Gate: probably `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_OBSERVER_AGENTS` (name only, Not verified). Message kinds `observer` and `observer-activity` exist. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | Bundle |
| 🔍 🧪 | `observerMessage` | Text appended to each activity digest sent to the observer. | String. Appended after the harness default. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | Bundle |
| 🔍 🧪 | `observeSubagents` | Whether subagents inherit the observer. | Boolean, default true. `false` stops inheritance. | Any agent file or `--agents` JSON. | Bundle |

## Rules for Files

- Claude Code skips a file with no `name`, with an opening `---` that is not on line 1, with a bad `name`, with no `description`, or with YAML that does not parse.
  Details go to the `--debug` log.
- A plugin agent whose frontmatter has no `name` or does not parse still loads, under its file name.
- A plugin agent is named `plugin:folder:file`.
  A file at `agents/review/security.md` in `my-plugin` is `my-plugin:review:security`.
- The bundle may normalize the spelling of keys when it reads frontmatter.
  The exact rule is not verified.
- A plugin agent cannot use `permissionMode`, `hooks`, or `mcpServers`.
- A second internal list names `initialPrompt`, `observer`, `observerMessage`, and `observeSubagents`.
  Its use is not verified.

## `--agents` JSON

`--agents` takes a JSON object.
Each key is an agent name, and the value uses these fields (from the bundle schema):
`description` (required), `prompt` (required), `tools`, `disallowedTools`, `model`, `effort` (level or integer), `permissionMode`, `mcpServers`, `hooks`, `maxTurns`, `autoCompactWindow`, `skills`, `initialPrompt`, `memory`, `background`, `omitClaudeMd`, `isolation`, `observer`, `observerMessage`, `observeSubagents`.
The `prompt` field replaces the file body.
It has priority 2, below managed settings.
In print mode (`-p`) `--agents` also takes a file path since `2.1.281`.
In an interactive session a path is refused ([Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents)).
The same schema is used by the plugin mod call `$.agent.register` (see [Mod API](Claude-Code-Mod-API)).
